notes.title: Locations in the game: from modern times to the 14th century
notes.content:
Traveling blogger Maxim in the Samara region will not be limited to the modern setting. The unique idea of the project was that Max gets into an anomalous zone, where everything moves not according to the laws of time, physics, reasonable sense. Before the player will open not just the caves of the Zhigulev Mountains or the shore on the Volga. Each location is a transition, sometimes to a new era, a kind of time travel.

[h2]What locations are waiting for Max and the players?[/h2]
[list]
[*] ship Samara
[*] Volga river bank
[*] dangerous cave of the Zhigulev Mountains
[*] a gloomy dungeon at the turn of the 14th century
[*] lost castle of the 14th century
[*] path out of time and space
[*] abandoned village of the 19th century
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693591/daf2920eebca7b405656098dd14a2742fa4cd0e6.jpg[/img]

Each location is unique, carries its own message, filled with collectibles and lore. We realize that it was easier to create a game on one location, for example, Max gets to the village and all the events take place there. And believe me, there is a lot of room for a couple or three hours of gameplay. But we liked the idea of smoothly leading the player into this crazy adventure, introducing the variety of possibilities, throwing more thematic features. 

For example, each era has its own [b]identifying marks[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693591/f2754fc50012d6b9da4c310c64ac3f00109b20df.jpg[/img]

its own [b]loot bags[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693591/aefd57ab14261de69f2ace9cf6cd989835888c87.jpg[/img]

its own [b]finds and memories[/b], its own [b]types of monsters[/b], and even its own [b]seasons and weather[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693591/6030a30ea7253654c6c01e26c9ffe62c8a7e12bf.jpg[/img]

The total passage time, according to our predictions, will take [b]6-7 hours[/b].

[b]Together with you we are waiting for the start of this journey. Blogger Maxim Elizarov will soon go to the Samara region to dispel the myths about this anomalous zone.  [/b]

notes.title: Characters and monsters in the game
notes.content:
All NPCs in the game are made by hand. This is important to note, as indie developers often use special services that help generate characters. For example, MetaHuman.

But in The Temple of the Green Moon every character and monster is rendered by our 3D artists and has an exclusive 3D model. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693591/fca29505ba87deb9826aab39e20bd1b8feca4f04.jpg[/img]

[h3]In the game you will meet important story characters: [/h3]
[list]
[*] a mysterious man whom you will meet in two different eras,
[*] an old ghost in a medieval castle, 
[*] a fortune-teller in an abandoned village. 
[/list]

Key story characters will be featured in cutscenes with dialog and unique animations. 

In addition, the bestiary of the Temple of the Green Moon has been enriched with ghosts, runners, an unkillable monster in the castle library and other dangerous and original creatures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693591/bef1edbb370750efbd52f091507025d854e30d72.jpg[/img]

We worked out each character separately, trying to achieve originality and authenticity in their appearance and behavior.

notes.title: Cut scenes and voice acting at the Temple of the Green Moon
notes.content:
In the game Temple of the Green Moon will be voiced all the lines of the main character, as well as dialog with all NPCs. In addition to individual phrases during the journey, the game will have cut-scenes with several characters. You will hear live dialog.

The main character Max will say not only duty jokes, but also be scared and horrified by what is happening.

What could be the reaction of a person seeing a ghost for the first time? We think that the Green Moon Temple's version is quite believable!

Through the character's voice you will be able to trace the changes that will happen to the main character. He will go from a skeptic and a joker to a man who knows that our world is not so simple and carries mystical secrets.

notes.title: FAQ
notes.content:
Today we will answer frequently asked questions about the game.

[b]Question:[/b] Why does the demo weigh so much? How much will the main game weigh?
[b]Answer: [/b]For technical reasons the main game has been added to the demo. Therefore, the main project will weigh 27 - 30 GB, no more.

[b]Question:[/b] When will the release be?
[b]Answer:[/b] The game will be released in April 2025.

[b]Question:[/b] Why does the game have locations from different countries?
[b]Answer:[/b] Because a game is always a fictional universe. Our story is based on the legends and myths of Russia, but it's a fantasy story. By interacting with an abnormal zone our hero gets into a different world, not like our reality.

[b]Question: [/b]What is the genre of the game?
[b]Answer: [/b]Mystical thriller, action adventure, a little bit of horror.

[b]Question: [/b]Does the game have investors or publishers?
[b]Answer: [/b]No. Olkon Games studio is fully sponsored by its creator Oleg Konovalenko and is 100% independent.

[b]Question: [/b]Where is the studio located?
[b]Answer: [/b]In Russia, in the city of Samara. But there are also employees who work in other cities.

[b]Question:[/b] What will be the gameplay? What will the game be like?
[b]Answer:[/b] Firewatch, Alan Wake, Outlast, Resident Evil.

[b]Question:[/b] Where will the game be available to buy, on what platform? Where can I add it to my Wishlist?
[b]Answer: [/b]First we will release on Steam, after that we will port the game to consoles: Playstation, Xbox, Nintendo.

After observing how the demo was played, we decided to increase the battle scenes in the game. Most of the players liked it and based on this experience we made this decision. Initially we wanted to make a horror game, but in the process we realized that we liked another genre and the game changed smoothly and organically. Yes, it will have horror elements, but we will no longer position the game as a horror.

[b]We make the game for you, dear players! And we want you to have fun and enjoy playing our games. The audience of the game is growing and we are very happy about it!
[/b]

notes.title: What the Temple of the Green Moon will be like: our progress
notes.content:
After a year of work, we already have an idea of the game Temple of the Green Moon.

Our project is not only a walking simulator. We use game mechanics that will force the player to be an active participant in the events.

You will have to keep an eye on the charge of your flashlight and collect batteries. The hero of the game is not defenseless. He will be able to fight back the dangerous inhabitants from the mysterious places where you will get them.

The release version of the game Temple of the Green Moon will be more hardcore. But not only scary moments are waiting for you. The game will have a mysterious story and beautiful and safe locations. The Unreal Engine 5 engine capabilities allowed us to create realistic environments and fantastic locations!

The events of the game take place not only in caves and forests. You will visit sunny beaches, get into the winter cold. There is a possibility of sudden time travel!

[b]In the Temple of the Green Moon are waiting for you:[/b]
[list]
[*] No less than 7 locations: caves, forest, bandit dungeons, sunny beaches, snowy plains, a 19th century hut and even a medieval castle
[*] OST of original indie music
[*] Character voice acting by professional actors who have worked on Uncharted, Assassin's Creed, Far Cry, Cyberpunk 2077 and other games and movies
[*] Dangerous enemies that you will be able to deal with in various ways
[*] Complex puzzles
[*] Traps
[*] And difficult moral choices in the story
[/list]

notes.title: Voice acting in the game: what languages and actors are expected?
notes.content:
Voice-overs in games play a huge role, we all enjoy immersing ourselves in the process of passing, when we hear the emotions of the characters, live with them what is happening. That's why we decided to add voice-overs in Russian and English. 

There are not so many dialogs in the game, but they will be. The main character Max meets several people on his way (or not a person at all), and also sometimes comments on what is happening - a common technique that allows you to feel the hero, to catch his mood: irony, surprise, fear, despair.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693591/76a567e2233b6e50419cde87d5b5e0d8693aff43.jpg[/img]

[h2]Which voice actors are involved in the development?[/h2]
[h3]Russian voice actors[/h3]
[b]Denis Bespaly[/b] - the voice of Nathan Drake in the Uncharted series, characters in Assassin's Creed, Far Cry, Cyberpunk 2077 and other games and movies
[b]Alexandra Kizhaeva[/b] - voice in Control, Cyberpunk 2077 games
[b]Mikhail Tikhonov[/b] - especially known for the voice of Dean from Supernatural, but has voiced a huge number of characters in movies and games, such as Assassin's Creed III, Batman: Arkham Asylum, StarCraft II: Wings of Liberty.

[h3]English voiceover[/h3]
One of the characters and the first teaser is voiced by singer and actor [b]Brandon Baumann[/b]. 

We are in talks with other actors for the roles of characters not yet voiced. And strive as much as possible to make our game “Temple of the Green Moon” sound atmospheric with a combination of professional voices and quality sound design.

notes.title: Bringing the world to life: unique 3D objects from our studio
notes.content:
If you've ever developed a game, you know how it is: initial ideas are regularly refined, the project can be polished and improved over the years, new details, nuances, and objects can be added.

At some point we realized that our universe will be unique. We don't want to just copy locations, create what has already been created. Our goal was to diversify the game world with the help of unique 3D objects, brands created by us, funny references. The player will be able to explore locations, interact with objects, and get into the atmosphere. 

To date, our artists have created about [b]50 unique 3D-objects[/b]: we take into account both large objects of the environment - statues, bridges, and small objects that can be lifted, twirled in your hand, and examined. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693591/913f6865f46a1586318ce07e09881ec33ca9c104.jpg[/img]

A can of lemonade, a bottle of foamy drink, a chocolate bar, a tape from the 90s, even the simplest can opener we have added interesting references for studying. 

In order to make the content understandable to our players from any country, when studying an item, a translation into English will be displayed on the screen. 

[b]Do you like to look at non-standard objects in games?[/b]

notes.title: 8 months of development: what results have been achieved?
notes.content:
Calculated, analyzed. What work was done between September 2023 and May 2024?

✅ GDD-document worked out: scenario, description of mechanics, puzzles, events, collections
✅ location ship is ready
✅ shore location ready
✅ cave location ready
✅ dungeon location - 70% ready
✅ 63 unique 2D images created
✅ 4 unique 3D character models created
✅ 40 unique 3D props, environment objects created
✅ 16 unique vfx effects created
✅ 15 unique animations created
✅ created sound design for locations: ship, shore, cave
✅ 1 music track was written
✅ released alpha version for festivals
✅ designed pages in Steam, VK Play
✅ held more than a hundred meetings
✅ 153 materials with content were posted in the public

[b]And this is just the beginning![/b].

It's hard to analyze whether this is a lot or not. It was possible to develop faster, we won't argue, but we are in no hurry. We don't have a goal to create and release the project in a year. The main goal is to make it as high quality as possible, so that the players really enjoy passing the “Temple of the Green Moon”.

notes.title: Introduction and stages of the project
notes.content:
Adventurers!

Last year we launched the development of the "Temple of the Green Moon" project. We wanted to familiarize the audience with real locations that actually exist: the Samarskaya Luka, the Zhigulev Mountains.

If you live in Russia, you've probably heard about anomalous zones. According to rumors and eyewitness accounts, the devil is going on here: people see mirages, hear strange sounds, and time seems to stop. Our hero - blogger Max goes to the Zhigulev Mountains to dispel the myths of the area. And as is usually the case in horror movies, something goes wrong.... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693591/19804fe6fef620508a8a46bf69bd4f456cb47f69.png[/img]

We will keep you informed about the main news of the project, tell you about the stages of development. 

[b]Planning:[/b]
✅ Teaser - April 2024
✅ Demo - June 2024
✅ Trailer - summer/fall 2024
✅ Release - end of 2024/beginning of 2025.

[b]Add the game to your wishlist if you haven't already, stay tuned for more news and project development![/b]
